listings.title: Chalet on the Oberbort with views of the Wasserngrat
listings.description:
A large chalet on the sunny Oberbort slope, a few minutes above the Promenade, facing the Wasserngrat and the Eggli.

Living room with an open fireplace and a dining area for twelve, a separate kitchen, six bedrooms with their own bathrooms and a staff studio. The ground floor has a ski room, a wine cellar and a garage for four cars.

South-facing terrace of 140 m² and a garden of 1,450 m². Built in 2016 in larch and stone, heated by a heat pump.

listings.description:
A chalet in a quiet residential street, a five-minute walk from the Promenade and the Gstaad train station.

Open living room under exposed beams with a stone fireplace, a dining room and a fitted kitchen. Five bedrooms on the two upper floors, four bathrooms. Ski room and double garage.

Garden of 900 m² with a covered terrace. Built in 2012, maintained by the same owners since.

Garden of 1,100 m² with a sunny terrace. Built in 2009.

listings.title: Furnished chalet apartment for the winter season
listings.description:
A furnished apartment on the first floor of a chalet on the Lauenenstrasse, a ten-minute walk from the Promenade.

Living room with a brick fireplace and wood panelling, open kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Linen, weekly cleaning and a parking space included.

Available from 15 December 2026 to 15 April 2027, minimum four months. Rent per month, charges and heating included in the extra costs.

listings.description:

Living room with a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace and large windows, kitchen, five bedrooms with bathrooms. The lower floor has an indoor pool, a sauna and a fitness room.

Plot of 1,300 m², garage for three cars. Built in 2021 to Minergie standard.

listings.title: Chalet with a glazed living room, Wispile
listings.description:
A chalet at the foot of the Wispile, on the road to Gsteig, five minutes from the centre of Gstaad.

The living room is a glazed room of 120 m² under a timber roof, with a central suspended fireplace and old brick walls. Five bedrooms with bathrooms, separate kitchen and a staff apartment.

Garden of 1,600 m² with a view of the Wispile slopes. Built in 2019.

listings.title: Lakefront house with private jetty, Collonge-Bellerive
listings.description:
A contemporary house directly on the lake in Collonge-Bellerive, with its own jetty and a view across to the Jura.

The living room, dining room and kitchen are glazed on three sides and open onto the lake. Five bedrooms with bathrooms, a study and a roof terrace.

Garden of 2,600 m² with a pool and a boathouse. Built in 2018. Fifteen minutes from the centre of Geneva.

listings.title: Provençal bastide with pool, Ramatuelle
listings.description:
A stone bastide in the countryside of Ramatuelle, between vineyards and umbrella pines, five minutes from the Pampelonne beaches.

Living room with beams and terracotta floors, country kitchen, six bedrooms in Provençal style and five bathrooms. Covered terrace and summer kitchen next to the pool.

Grounds of 9,500 m² with olive trees. House dating from the late 19th century, restored in 2017.
